purpose: Desktop team, agent, workflow and bounded-loop product development. This is not formal node approval.

semantics.start_after: A usable, frozen local interface or implementation handoff is required; final product acceptance may remain pending.
semantics.accept_after: Required integration evidence must be available before accepting the task.
semantics.blocked_dependency: Pause affected edges only. Do not claim missing evidence passed or start a formally unauthorized successor node.
semantics.report_gate: Known blocked conclusions permit a partial report, not FEATURE_ACCEPTED.

invariants: A frontend fixture supports parallel development but never satisfies final Host or product acceptance.
C06, C07 and C08 serialize edits to scheduler-core.
Shared package exports, routes, locales, manifests and generated files are integrated by the coordinator.
No new paid product call or credential access is authorized by this scheduling file.
An accepted UI-only task does not count as a completed team or workflow product feature.
Final candidate review freezes all implementation writers.
B01 unresolved safety and P0 prerequisites are not silently marked complete.
